enemy.name: Reminiscence
enemy.flavour_text: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a common water pot, it was not discarded even after its original purpose had become obsolete, being passed down through the family as a storage pot. Reach inside, and one can often find trinkets thought lost.

abilities.text: Can collect up to 1 <Vapidity> or <Sapidity>; On collection, activates and becomes aerial, moving towards <Derelict Stove>
